title: High-Protein Chicken & Quinoa Meal-Prep Bowls
seoTitle: High-Protein Chicken & Quinoa Meal-Prep Bowls | Firefighter Meal
shortDescription: Roasted chicken and quinoa with vegetables, built specifically for individual meal-prep containers
subtitle: Roasted chicken and quinoa with vegetables, built specifically for individual meal-prep containers
description: Roasted chicken thighs, quinoa, and roasted vegetables are portioned into individual containers with a simple herb dressing on the side, designed specifically for crews prepping meals ahead of a shift.

steps.title: Season and roast the chicken
steps.instruction: Heat the oven to 425°F. Toss chicken thighs with olive oil, garlic powder, smoked paprika, salt, and pepper on a sheet pan. Roast 22–25 minutes until 165°F at the thickest point. Target oven/smoker temperature: 425°F.

steps.title: Cook the quinoa
steps.instruction: Rinse quinoa and simmer with water in a lidded pot 15 minutes until tender. Fluff and spread on a sheet pan to cool.

steps.title: Roast the vegetables
steps.instruction: Toss broccoli and bell pepper with olive oil, salt, and pepper on a separate sheet pan. Roast 16–18 minutes alongside the chicken until tender with browned edges. Target oven/smoker temperature: 425°F.

steps.title: Mix the dressing
steps.instruction: Whisk lemon juice, olive oil, oregano, salt, and pepper in a small container. Keep it separate from the bowls until eating time.

steps.title: Slice the chicken
steps.instruction: Rest chicken 5 minutes, then slice into strips for even portioning across containers.

steps.title: Portion into containers
steps.instruction: Divide quinoa, roasted vegetables, and sliced chicken evenly across 8 containers. Let everything cool with lids off for 15–20 minutes before sealing and refrigerating.

proTips: Prep tip: Let food cool before sealing containers — trapped steam leads to soggy quinoa and shortens shelf life.
Rookie tip: Keep the dressing in small separate cups so vegetables stay crisp until the moment of eating.
Weigh or eyeball even portions across containers so everyone gets a consistent amount of protein.
Label containers with the date — this recipe is meant for the fridge, not indefinite storage.
tonightSpread: Main: Chicken and quinoa meal-prep bowls
Sides: Extra roasted vegetables, fresh fruit
Condiments: Hot sauce, extra lemon dressing
Set hot components closest to the crew; cold crunch and toppings at the far end of the line.
Keep a backup tray at 200°F for firefighters returning from a run.
leftovers: Refrigerate portioned containers up to 4 days, or freeze without dressing up to 2 months.
Reheat covered to 165°F, then add dressing after reheating so vegetables don't turn soggy.
Thaw frozen portions overnight in the refrigerator before reheating.
whyCrewsLikeIt: It is built for the reality of shift work — portioned, labeled, and ready to grab — with a protein and fiber count that holds crews over during a long stretch without a real meal break.
mealPrepNotes: Make-ahead: this recipe is built entirely for advance portioning. Storage: pack into 8 individual containers; refrigerate up to 4 days or freeze up to 2 months without the dressing. Reheating: heat to 165°F, then add dressing after.
substitutions: Use chicken breast instead of thighs for a leaner version.
Use brown rice instead of quinoa.
Use zucchini or green beans instead of broccoli.
